NOW THEREFORE, we, Union Trust Bank of India, do hereby irrevocably and unconditionally guarantee to pay to you, on first written demand without protest or demur, an amount not exceeding INR 1.52 Cr (Rupees 1.52 Crore Only), being Performance Bond amount, subject to the following terms: Terms and Conditions Liability: Our total liability under this Bank Guarantee shall not exceed INR 1.52 Cr (India Rupees Rupees 1.52 Crore Only). Validity: This Guarantee shall remain valid from 2023-04-08 until 2026-07-20 (the "Expiry Date") unless extended by mutual consent in writing. Claim Period: We shall be liable to pay under this guarantee only if a written claim or demand is served upon us on or before the Expiry Date. Enforceability: Any claim arising under this guarantee shall be enforceable at our branch office at Mumbai or at any scheduled bank branch in India as nominated by the claimant. No Defence: Our obligation to pay is absolute and unconditional. We shall have no right of set- off, counterclaim, or defence arising from any dispute between the Contractor and the Employer. Modification: This guarantee shall not be affected by any change in the constitution, ownership, or control of the Contractor or the Employer. 1. 2. 3. 4. 5. 6.
